scenes.bubble: A new ERP will fix our reports.
scenes.caption: Myth or fact?
scenes.say: Myth or fact? A new E.R.P. will fix our reporting.

scenes.head: A new system only reports what you put into it.
scenes.say: In our view, mostly myth. A new system only reports what you put into it. If the old data, chart of accounts and habits move across unchanged, so do the reporting problems.

items.l: Who does what, by which day

scenes.say: So fix three things before go-live: a chart of accounts built for the reports you need, clean master data, and a written close process.
